answer_1.quote: We propose an LLM-based proactive recommendation agent capable of dynamically incorporating real-time user feedback while optimizing for long-term rewards in proactive recommendation.
answer_1.outputs: recommended items and strategic thoughts guiding user interest toward a target item

answer_2.quote: To comprehensively assess the methods, we employ both LLM-based and traditional metrics. LLM-based metrics leverage autonomous LLMs to simulate users to assess the effectiveness of the recommendations. Conversely, traditional metrics are based on a simulator that utilizes the Transformer model to evaluate the performance.

answer_3.quote: We implement metrics Coherence and Acceptance in prior work to appropriately evaluate the LLM-based method, as LLMs are more capable of revealing the latent relationships between items than traditional metrics.
